visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Use the Modulo-9 Formula
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Nested loops add digits repeatedly. Replace them with the closed form: the digital root of n is 1 + (n - 1) % 9 for n greater than 0. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A number and its digit sum leave the same remainder when divided by 9, so repeating the digit sum ends at the number's remainder mod 9, with 9 used instead of 0. The formula needs no loops.
